_comment: Hand-maintained supplement to ~/.claude/manifest.json for brain-map/generate.py. manifest.json is the live source for the skill list and calls: edges. Autonomous Agents, Infrastructure, and Cross-Machine Network trunks are now ALSO live-derived (from launchd plists, settings.local.json hooks, and marvin-network.json respectively — see ADRs 0018/0019/0020) with this file supplying only optional overrides + the handful of nodes with no live source at all (Memory's ChromaDB/hook nodes, exo, task-dispatch).

root.desc: Memory, routing, and skills layer for Claude Code

children.desc: Scans a project on demand, extracts patterns
Lateral + direct retrieval — creative's cross-domain synthesis reads this
Manual pattern capture; shared by the session-capture hook
ChromaDB — arXiv/GitHub/HN items, deduped by URL hash
ChromaDB — citation-graph traversal results, deduped across investigations
Greedy best-first traversal, blended SPECTER2+nomic-embed scoring, now its own repo
References+citations from Semantic Scholar, asymmetric caps + result-intent bypass
Auto-generated skill index — this graph's real source of truth

structural.desc: The hooks wiring everything else together — live-derived from settings.local.json, see ADR 0019
Run on a schedule, without being invoked — live-derived from launchd, see ADR 0018
Registered machines + distributed-systems primitives — see ADR 0020

skill_desc_overrides.grill-me: Relentless Socratic interview — now the fallback
skill_desc_overrides.grill-with-docs: grill-me + live CONTEXT.md/ADR updates — the preferred default
skill_desc_overrides.architecture-review: Reviews the whole system — renamed from self-optimize tonight
skill_desc_overrides.project-ai-development-theory: Open thread — what's the developmental stage after tools→skills, via a psychology lens
skill_desc_overrides.reference-mcp: MCP protocol knowledge base — architecture, transports, auth, extensions, debugging, registry

daily-digest.desc: Cron 08:30 — brainstorms feature combos, trim candidates, wild ideas

children.desc: the actual output — was silently broken until tonight
synthesizes into Directly Relevant / Lateral / Tools / Skip

rebuild-manifest.py.desc: Rebuilds manifest.json from skill frontmatter — now path-scoped, not unconditional; also chains a brain-map regenerate

emit-resume-prompt.py.desc: Hook: prints the resume prompt on handoff-doc writes

qa_session_capture.py.desc: Hook: extracts decisions from handoffs into qa-knowledge

improvement_sweep.py.desc: Hook: scans the handoff's project, queues top issues

extra_nodes.desc: Distributed LLM inference across registered devices over Tailscale — fully working 2026-07-08
General fan-out/merge dispatch primitive (lib/task_dispatch.py) — research-colony's cross-machine merge trigger runs on it

synapse_labels.grill-with-docs->grill-me: calls grill-me's interview process, then layers doc-updates on top
synapse_labels.grill-with-docs->lexicon: calls lexicon to resolve/record terms as they crystallize
synapse_labels.improve-codebase-architecture->zoom-out: calls zoom-out for the initial map before finding deepening opportunities
synapse_labels.index->self-improve: runs self-improve's retrieve.py + rebuild-manifest.py under the hood
synapse_labels.qa-agent->self-improve: calls self-improve to turn QA-observed patterns into new/updated skills
synapse_labels.self-improve->lexicon: calls lexicon — step 1 of its own process
synapse_labels.self-improve->write-a-skill: calls write-a-skill's process when authoring a brand-new skill
synapse_labels.tdd->diagnose: calls diagnose when a red test needs root-causing, not just a fix
synapse_labels.to-prd->to-issues: calls to-issues once the PRD is synthesized
synapse_labels.triage->to-issues: calls to-issues once an item is triaged

extra_synapses.label: qa_scan.py/qa_capture.py write scan results and manual captures here — qa-agent's core purpose, previously missing from this graph entirely
cross_domain_synthesis.py directly imports qa_query.py and reads this — not a qa-agent invocation, bypasses it entirely; never declared in frontmatter
PostToolUse hook fires on every handoff-doc write
PostToolUse hook fires on every handoff-doc write
PostToolUse hook fires on every handoff-doc write
rewrites manifest.json on every relevant SKILL.md/memory edit
owns and triggers the daily-digest cron
reads qa-knowledge as part of its assembled context
correlate.py cross-refs today's finds against qa-knowledge
source_monitor.py writes here, correlate.py reads it back
paper_graph.py's /paper-graph mode writes and reads here — added 2026-07-08, previously missing from this graph entirely (same gap class as qa-agent above)
migrated to task-dispatch's fan-out/merge primitive, event-driven instead of purely cron-timed
syncs qa-knowledge/research-feed across every device registered here

_writer_helpers: Modules that write on behalf of their callers: a script calling job_events.job_run feeds the Activity tab's job runs.
_dashboard_tab_readers: Keys are the tab NODE ids; files are relative to dashboard/electron/main. A missing file or key is warned about by generate.py.
_skill_projects: Skill -> project node when the names differ (a project:<skill> node is matched automatically).
_plain: One kindergarten-simple line per node (what it is, what it does for MARVIN), shown first on hover. Keep under ~20 words. generate.py names any node without one. Locked (private) projects never show theirs on the website.

plain.MARVIN: Gil's helper brain. It remembers, learns new tricks, and keeps his projects moving.
plain.Memory: Where MARVIN keeps what it learned, so it doesn't forget between chats.
plain.qa-knowledge: A notebook of what worked and what broke, so the same mistake doesn't happen twice.
plain.qa_scan.py: Looks through a project and writes down the good and bad habits it finds.
plain.qa_query.py: Searches the notebook for a lesson that fits the problem right now.
plain.qa_capture.py: Writes a new lesson into the notebook.
plain.research-feed: A pile of new science and tech news MARVIN collected to read.
plain.paper-knowledge: A map of science papers and which papers point to which.
plain.paper_graph.py: Follows the links between papers to find the best ones to read next.
plain.fetch_neighbors_from_s2: Asks a big paper library which papers a paper cites, and which cite it.
plain.lexicon.md: A word list, so Gil and MARVIN mean the same thing by the same word.
plain.manifest.json: The table of contents for every skill MARVIN has. This map is drawn from it.
plain.Skills: The things MARVIN knows how to do, like tools in a toolbox.
plain.Quality: Skills for checking work and finding what's broken.
plain.audit: Checks whether things really work the way the notes say they do.
plain.diagnose: A careful, step-by-step way to find out why something is broken.
plain.grill-me: Asks lots of hard questions so a plan has no holes.
plain.grill-with-docs: Asks hard questions about a plan and writes the answers into the project's notes.
plain.improve-codebase-architecture: Finds ways to tidy code so it's easier to change and test.
plain.qa-agent: Learns good habits from projects and remembers them for next time.
plain.tdd: Write a test first, watch it fail, then make it pass. Small, safe steps.
plain.Research: Skills for learning about new things.
plain.paper-dive: A reading buddy that helps Gil understand hard science papers.
plain.project-ai-development-theory: A big question Gil is thinking about: how do AI helpers grow up, step by step?
plain.reference-mcp: Notes on MCP, the plug that lets AI helpers use other tools.
plain.research: Digs into a question carefully and says how sure it is about each answer.
plain.zoom-out: Steps back to show the big picture of how the pieces fit.
plain.Creation: Skills for making new things and new ideas.
plain.creative: Helps come up with ideas that aren't the boring, obvious ones.
plain.improve: Keeps a list of things to make better and picks what to fix next.
plain.prototype: Builds a quick rough version to try an idea before building it for real.
plain.Continuity: Skills that help MARVIN pick up smoothly from one day to the next.
plain.architecture-review: Looks over the whole system now and then and suggests how to make it simpler.
plain.caveman: Talks in very short words to save time and money.
plain.handoff: Writes a note about where things stand before switching tasks, so nothing gets lost.
plain.index: Finds just the skill pages a job needs, instead of reading them all.
plain.lexicon: Adds new words to the shared word list.
plain.route: Picks the right AI helper for each job, like picking the right-size wrench.
plain.safety-monitor: Checks MARVIN's own work for made-up facts before anyone sees it.
plain.self-improve: After a job, MARVIN looks back and writes down how to do better.
plain.write-a-skill: Teaches MARVIN a new skill by writing its how-to page.
plain.Project: Skills for planning and running projects.
plain.resume-tailor: Makes Gil's resume fit one specific job, on one page.
plain.setup-matt-pocock-skills: Sets up a new project so the planning skills know where its to-do list lives.
plain.to-issues: Cuts a big plan into small to-do tickets.
plain.to-prd: Turns a chat about an idea into a written plan.
plain.triage: Sorts new tickets: what's ready, what needs a person, what can wait.
plain.Other: Skills that haven't been put in a group yet.
plain.portfolio-page: Builds a page about one of Gil's projects for his website, with real proof.
plain.readme: Writes a project's welcome page, so a stranger can get it running.
plain.to-tasklist: Turns a plan into a checklist when a project has no ticket board.
plain.variable-tracker: Follows a name through the code to show everywhere it's used.
plain.writing-style: Makes writing sound like Gil, not like a robot.
plain.Infrastructure: The wiring that makes things happen on their own, at the right moment.
plain.auto_route_hook.py: When a chat starts, it guesses what kind of job it is and suggests the best helper.
plain.background_review.py: After a handoff note is saved, quietly checks for a lesson worth keeping.
plain.emit-resume-prompt.py: Prints the 'pick up where we left off' message when a handoff note is saved.
plain.gh_merge_guard.py: A gate that stops code from being merged when it shouldn't be.
plain.improvement_sweep.py: After a handoff, finds that project's biggest problems and lists them.
plain.qa_session_capture.py: Copies decisions from handoff notes into the lessons notebook.
plain.rebuild-manifest.py: Updates the skill table of contents when a skill changes, then redraws this map.
plain.session_start_report.py: At the start of every chat, gives a quick report of what needs attention.
plain.skill_activity.py: Notes every time a skill is used, so this map can light it up.
plain.trigger_code_sync.py: When a handoff note is saved, copies the work over to the other computer.
plain.Autonomous Agents: Helpers that work by themselves on a schedule, like an alarm clock.
plain.cleanup-sweep: Every night, sweeps up leftovers from finished work to free up space.
plain.code-sync-push: Every 30 minutes, keeps both computers' copies of MARVIN the same.
plain.cross-machine-merge: Each morning, puts together what both computers made.
plain.daily-digest: Every morning, writes Gil a short note with ideas and things to fix.
plain.reads: qa-knowledge: Reads the lessons notebook for ideas.
plain.reads: roadmap + handoffs: Reads the plans and handoff notes to know what's going on.
plain.research-colony: Every morning, gathers new AI news and picks out what matters for MARVIN.
plain.source_monitor.py: Collects new papers and posts from science and tech sites.
plain.correlate.py: Checks which new items connect to what MARVIN already knows.
plain.research_digest.py: Writes the news up as a short list: useful, maybe useful, skip.
plain.ticket-pipeline: Every hour, takes the next ticket from the to-do list and has a helper build it.
plain.usage-scan: Every hour, counts how much AI each job used, so costs stay low.
plain.auto-fix: Fixes tiny, safe things in MARVIN's own code by itself, like typos.
plain.cron-health: Every day, checks that each scheduled helper really ran.
plain.health-check: Every 15 minutes, checks each part of MARVIN and flags anything that's not OK.
plain.process-quarantine-reviews: Uses Gil's reviews of held-back work to judge better next time.
plain.Cross-Machine Network: MARVIN's computers, and how they share the work.
plain.mac-mini-1: The always-on computer at home. It does most of the work.
plain.macbook-pro-1: Gil's laptop. It helps out when it's open and awake.
plain.exo: Lets both computers team up to run one big AI together.
plain.task-dispatch: Hands each job to whichever computer is free.
plain.Dashboard: The app where Gil watches what MARVIN is doing and tells it what to do.
plain.Metrics tab: Shows the numbers: how much AI was used and how well things are working.
plain.MR Review tab: Where Gil checks finished code and says yes or no before it's added.
plain.Health tab: Shows green, yellow or red for each part of MARVIN.
plain.Docs tab: Every project's notes and plans, in one place to read.
plain.Activity tab: Shows what's happening right now, and each project's to-do board.
plain.Portfolio tab: Where Gil works on his portfolio website.
plain.Projects: The things Gil is building, with MARVIN's help.
plain.anomaly-detection-v2: The second try at spotting sneaky traffic on a home network.
plain.anthropic-fellows-memory-paper: A research paper asking: does giving an AI a memory make it less careful?
plain.clarity-captions: An iPhone app that shows what people say as big, easy-to-read words, live.
plain.eagle project: Gil's Eagle Scout project: the plans, photos and costs.
plain.finance-os: A money app for planning a budget. The money info never leaves the computer.
plain.ingested-repos: Other people's code that MARVIN studied to learn good ideas.
plain.killer-sudoku: A Mac puzzle game: Sudoku where the boxes add up to sums. No ads, ever.
plain.MechanicGPT: An AI helper for car repair questions.
plain.mitre-technique-prediction: Reads how a cyberattack happened and guesses which known tricks the attacker used.
plain.ML-Powered-Resume-Selector-using-Naive-B: Sorts resumes by job type with simple math, then checks honestly how well it did.
plain.ML_unsupervised_learning-anomaly-detecti: Finds bad connections hiding in smart-device network traffic, without an answer key.
plain.nourished: An app for discovering dishes to eat, with a website and an iPhone app.
plain.OpenClaw: A personal AI assistant Gil runs in a sealed box to try it out.
plain.project:paper-dive: The paper reading buddy, packaged so other people can use it too.
plain.Personal-Website: An early start on Gil's personal website.
plain.portfolio-website-updater: Keeps Gil's portfolio website up to date with his newest work.
plain.Portfolio_Website: An older portfolio website, with its own small server.
plain.project:resume-tailor: The resume helper, packaged so other people can use it too.
plain.seal-icon-gen: Makes picture ideas for the Seal app's icon, with an AI on the computer.
plain.data: A folder of data for the network-traffic project.
plain.ex-exo: A copy of exo, the tool that lets computers team up to run AI.
